        move('left')
        print("Turning left")
    else:
        move('right')
        print("Turning right")

    # Increment time counter
    time += time_step

    # Render the scene
    vis.BeginScene()
    vis.Render()
    vis.EndScene()

    # Advance the simulation by one time step
    system.DoStepDynamics(time_step)
